title: Great photos
text: The photo shoot with Sagrada Familia was amazing. Rodri, the photographer, was very kind and carefully suggested a number of poses and the best shooting spots. They timed the shots so that no one else was seen in crowded and popular places, and they shot at very good angles in less crowded places. I'm very happy with everything. Thank you very much.
author: Shogo_M

title: Family photo session
text: I used viator to reserve my family 25 year marriage anniversary photos.  I couldn’t believe how reasonable the price was an so easy to book.  100 percent recommend them. Manu was our photographer, she was wonderful and so patient with us.  I called local photographers and they were 500 euros. I paid $126 for my 45 min session which actually lasted more than that at no additional charge. I am beyond happy with my pictures and this experience. Exactly what I was hoping for. Thank you!
